pageData.heading: Construction loan: Build your dream property
pageData.para: Build your dream home with a low-interest construction loan. Get funds in stages, pay interest only on what’s used, and enjoy flexible repayment options.

list.heading: Loan Disbursement in Phases–
list.desc: The bank releases funds after verifying the completion of specific construction.

list.heading: Loan Tenure–
list.desc: Typically, 10 to 30 years, depending on the bank and your profile.

list.heading: Loan-to-Value (LTV) Ratio–
list.desc: Banks finance 75% to 90% of construction costs while borrowers fund the rest. LTV is based on construction cost not land value.

list.heading: Property as Collateral–
list.desc: The land and the under-construction property are typically mortgaged until repayment.

list.heading: Monitoring & Inspections–
list.desc: Banks conduct regular site inspections to verify construction progress before disbursing the next installment.

list.heading: Tax Benefits–
list.desc: Similar to home loans, tax benefits are available under Section 80C (principal repayment) and Section 24(b) (interest paid), but only after construction is complete.

list.heading: Custom-Built Home–
list.desc: Enables you to build your dream home according to your preferences rather than buying a pre-built property.

list.heading: Preserve Your Savings–
list.desc: You don’t have to exhaust your savings instead, you can use loan funds for smooth cash flow management.

list.heading: Higher Loan Amount–
list.desc: Compared to personal loans, construction loans offer higher funding based on project cost and your eligibility.

list.heading: Flexible Repayment Options–
list.desc: During construction, banks may require only Pre-EMI (interest). Full EMI starts after full disbursement or project completion.

list.heading: Unlock the value–
list.desc: Once the house is complete, you will be eligible for a top-up loan for further expenses (like expansion of business, medical emergencies, higher education, weddings, foreign travel etc).

willApprove.heading: Will your loan get approved?
willApprove.para: Understanding your eligibility today can help you secure better loan terms and reduce repayment burdens in the future.

list.heading: Applicant's Financial Profile
desc: Income Stability – Banks assess salary slips or business financials.
Credit Score – A 700+ CIBIL score boosts approval chances.
Debt-to-Income Ratio – Lower existing loans for better eligibility.
list.para: Tip: Maintain good credit history & reduce debts before applying.

list.heading: Property & Loan-to-Value (LTV) Ratio
desc: Land Ownership – Must own the plot or have a valid sale agreement.
LTV Ratio – Banks fund up to 80%, requiring a 20% down payment.
Location & Approval – Plot must be in a lender-approved area with all permits.
list.para: Tip: Ensure clear land titles & approvals to avoid loan rejection.

list.heading: Documentation & Legal Compliance
desc: KYC Documents – PAN, Aadhaar, and address proof.
Income Proof – Salary slips & ITRs (salaried) / Business financials (self-employed).
Construction Plan & Cost Estimate – Architect-certified plan & cost estimate.
list.para: Tip: Keep all documents updated for faster approval.

list.heading: Eligibility for Balance Transfer–
list.desc:
Good repayment history on the current loan.
Credit score 750+ for better rates.
Construction progress proof required.
Stable income proof (salaried/self-employed).
Legally clear property with no disputes.

list.heading: Benefits of Balance Transfer–
list.desc:
Lower Interest Rates
Extended Loan Tenure
Top-Up Loan Option
Flexible Repayment Plans

list.heading: Steps to Transfer a Construction Loan–
list.desc:
Compare Lenders – Check interest rates, fees, and repayment terms.
Apply for Balance Transfer – Submit required documents (loan statement, income proof, property papers).
Loan Approval & Processing – The new lender will assess eligibility and approve the transfer.
Foreclosure of Existing Loan – Your current lender will close the loan, and the new lender will take over.
New Loan Agreement – You start repayment with the new lender under better terms.

topUp.heading: Top-Up Loan in Construction
topUp.para: A top-up loan is extra money you can borrow on top of your existing construction loan. It helps cover additional costs like construction extras, interior work, or unexpected expenses. These loans usually come with low interest rates but require a good repayment history.

cardData.title: Still confused?
cardData.para: If you need expert guidance, you can book an appointment for personalized advice. Get the right solutions tailored to your financial needs with a quick consultation.

list.text: Submit your loan application online or visit the bank with necessary details like income proof, property documents, and personal information.
The bank reviews your financial profile, credit score, and property documents before approving the loan amount and issuing a sanction letter.
Funds are released in stages based on construction milestones (e.g., foundation, walls, roof) to ensure proper utilization of the loan amount.
Once construction is completed and verified, the remaining loan amount is disbursed, and full EMI payments begin.

thinkYouShouldKnow.heading: Things you should know
paraGraph: Independent Facilitator: DigitalDSA operates as an independent loan facilitator and web aggregator, bridging the gap between loan consumers and licensed banks or NBFCs. We are not an authorized financial institution and do not offer loans directly.

Loan Approval: The sole discretion of approving or rejecting a loan lies with the respective bank or NBFC where the user applies. DigitalDSA does not guarantee loan approval or offer assurance from any specific bank or NBFC. All loans are subject to credit approval, and their terms, conditions, fees, and charges apply.
Liability: DigitalDSA is not responsible for any loss, damage, or failure at the user's end during loan processing. The final decision of the bank or NBFC is binding on both the user and DigitalDSA.

Important Information: This information is provided without considering your personal objectives, financial situation, or needs. Please assess its suitability before acting. Exclusive offers are available only when you avail of a loan through DigitalDSA and meet specific conditions.
